notes: Official USMLE physician tasks explicitly include nutritional underpinnings under foundational science.
Refeeding Syndrome StatPearls last updated November 7, 2022 and carried in the 2026 edition; insulin-driven intracellular phosphate/potassium shifts and hallmark hypophosphatemia directly supported.
Phosphate Physiology StatPearls in the 2026 edition independently corroborates insulin-mediated transcellular phosphate shift during refeeding.

duplicate_gate.selected_construct: Refeeding syndrome insulin-mediated intracellular phosphate shift

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Severely malnourished patient develops profound hypophosphatemia, hypokalemia, weakness and arrhythmia shortly after carbohydrate refeeding; rising insulin drives depleted phosphate/potassium intracellularly.
adversarial_second_pass.tumor_lysis_attack: Cell lysis releases rather than depletes extracellular phosphate and potassium.
adversarial_second_pass.PTH_attack: PTH renal phosphate wasting does not explain the abrupt multielectrolyte pattern tied to refeeding.
adversarial_second_pass.FGF23_attack: FGF23 causes renal phosphate wasting rather than simultaneous insulin-linked phosphate/potassium shifts after nutrition.
adversarial_second_pass.acid_base_attack: Respiratory acidosis is not the defining driver of the post-refeeding pattern.
